scope: setup.cfg.bak read whole and pin verified; README.rst1-225 read only, not whole documentation. Config/doc commands treated as data.

findings.detail: Backup config explicitly documents dropped Python2 support and old-version installation strategy. Its >=2.7 metadata is archived config, not evidence current package supports Python2.
README quickstart uses pff recovery twice, while actual pff facade registers recover plus repair_ecc/recc aliases, not recovery. Examples do not match registered commands.
Monitoring database append example lacks closing quote around your_folder. It is not a directly runnable shell example as printed.

README example explicitly repairs only three header bytes and leaves two corrupted body bytes while describing visually indistinguishable output. This is visual recovery, not byte identity; no visual assessment performed this review.
Package description is archival fixity/error correction, and pff dup means majority-vote repair from replicas. It is not a file-duplicate discovery operation despite candidate search keyword.
